turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Starting spindle diagnostic procedure.

ground_truth.node_text: Start

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Begin with a warm-up run. Bring the spindle up to 50% speed and let it run for 10 minutes.

ground_truth.node_text: Warm up run, spindle at 50% speed for 10 minutes

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Warm-up complete, spindle has been running at 50% for 10 minutes.

ground_truth.node_text: Warm up run, spindle at 50% speed for 10 minutes

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Mount a calibrated accelerometer on the front bearing housing using a flat washer stud or magnetic base. Run the spindle at 3000 RPM with no toolholder fitted and record the RMS vibration velocity in millimeters per second. Then repeat the measurement at maximum rated speed and compare both readings against the ISO 10816 zone limits.

ground_truth.node_text: Mount a calibrated accelerometer on the front bearing housing with a flat washer stud or magnetic base. Run the spindle at 3000 revolutions per minute with no toolholder fitted and record the root mean square vibration velocity in millimetres per second. Repeat at the maximum rated speed and compare both readings against the ISO 10816 zone limits for this machine class.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Accelerometer mounted and measurements taken at both 3000 RPM and max speed. I've recorded the vibration velocities and compared them to the zone limits.

ground_truth.node_text: Mount a calibrated accelerometer on the front bearing housing with a flat washer stud or magnetic base. Run the spindle at 3000 revolutions per minute with no toolholder fitted and record the root mean square vibration velocity in millimetres per second. Repeat at the maximum rated speed and compare both readings against the ISO 10816 zone limits for this machine class.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the vibration level below the alarm limit?

ground_truth.node_text: Vibration level below alarm limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Both readings are within acceptable range, well below the alarm threshold.

ground_truth.node_text: Vibration level below alarm limit?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the bearing temperature within the rated operating limit?

ground_truth.node_text: Bearing temperature within rated operating limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The bearing temperature is fine, but I'm noticing significant vibration at the motor mounting points that seems unusual for normal operation.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, both front and rear bearing housing temperatures are within normal limits. Temperature rise is under 25 degrees above ambient.

ground_truth.node_text: Bearing temperature within rated operating limit?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the radial runout within 2 micrometer tolerance?

ground_truth.node_text: Radial runout within 2 µm tolerance?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The runout measurement shows 3.2 micrometers total indicator reading. That's outside the 2 micrometer spec.

ground_truth.node_text: Radial runout within 2 µm tolerance?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the bearing preload via the locknut in quarter-turn increments.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust bearing pre load via locknut, quarter turn increments

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Preload adjustment complete. I've made a quarter-turn increment on the locknut.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust bearing pre load via locknut, quarter turn increments

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify the radial runout after the preload adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify radial runout after pre load adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Runout is now 1.8 micrometers. That's back within specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify radial runout after pre load adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the axial play within 3 micrometer tolerance?

ground_truth.node_text: Axial play within 3 µm tolerance?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I measured the axial deflection three times and averaged the results. The mean axial play is 2.5 micrometers, which is within the 3 micrometer limit.

ground_truth.node_text: Axial play within 3 µm tolerance?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the taper contact pattern above 85% bearing area?

ground_truth.node_text: Taper contact pattern above 85% bearing area?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The blue transferred uniformly across about 90% of the taper length. Contact pattern looks excellent.

ground_truth.node_text: Taper contact pattern above 85% bearing area?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the drawbar retention force within the rated range?

ground_truth.node_text: Drawbar retention force within rated range?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The dynamometer reading shows the retention force is about 15% below the minimum spec. The disc springs may be fatigued.

ground_truth.node_text: Drawbar retention force within rated range?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the drawbar spring stack or replace the disc springs.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust drawbar spring stack or replace disc springs

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I've adjusted the spring stack like you said, but now I'm seeing hydraulic fluid leaking from the drawbar cylinder seal — that wasn't happening before I started this procedure.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I've replaced the disc springs with fresh ones from the service kit. The stack is reassembled to spec.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust drawbar spring stack or replace disc springs

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Mount a dial test indicator against the reference artifact clamped in the spindle at cold start. Zero the indicator and run the spindle at operating speed for 30 minutes. Record the indicator displacement at 10-minute intervals and note the total thermal growth at stabilization, then compare it against the compensation table value.

ground_truth.node_text: Mount a dial test indicator against the reference artefact clamped in the spindle at cold start. Zero the indicator and allow the spindle to run at operating speed for 30 minutes. Record the indicator displacement at 10 minute intervals and note the total thermal growth value at stabilisation; compare against the growth compensation value stored in the machine thermal compensation table.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Thermal growth test complete. I've logged the readings at each interval and the spindle stabilized after 30 minutes.

ground_truth.node_text: Mount a dial test indicator against the reference artefact clamped in the spindle at cold start. Zero the indicator and allow the spindle to run at operating speed for 30 minutes. Record the indicator displacement at 10 minute intervals and note the total thermal growth value at stabilisation; compare against the growth compensation value stored in the machine thermal compensation table.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the thermal growth within the compensation model tolerance?

ground_truth.node_text: Thermal growth within compensation model tolerance?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The measured growth is diverging from the stored compensation value by more than the allowable tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Thermal growth within compensation model tolerance?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Complete the following checks: Read the thermal compensation growth coefficient from the controller, compare the stored values against the reference values for this spindle, and check whether the compensation parameters were modified since last service.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Read the thermal compensation growth coefficient from the controller. 2. Compare the stored values against the reference values for this spindle. 3. Check whether the compensation parameters were modified since last service.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: I've pulled the coefficients from the controller and cross-checked them. The parameters haven't been modified, but they differ slightly from the reference sheet.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Read the thermal compensation growth coefficient from the controller. 2. Compare the stored values against the reference values for this spindle. 3. Check whether the compensation parameters were modified since last service.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Reverify thermal compensation after the parameter update.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify thermal compensation after parameter update

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: After updating the parameters, the thermal growth now matches the model within tolerance.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify thermal compensation after parameter update

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the spindle speed within plus or minus 0.1% at all test speeds?

ground_truth.node_text: Spindle speed within ±0.1% at all test speeds?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The tachometer readings show errors slightly above 0.1% at two of the three test speeds.

ground_truth.node_text: Spindle speed within ±0.1% at all test speeds?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Adjust the speed reference gain in the drive parameter.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust speed reference gain in drive parameter

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Speed reference gain adjusted. The drive parameter has been updated.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust speed reference gain in drive parameter

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Run the spindle at maximum rated speed with the normal toolholder fitted for five minutes. Record the vibration velocity with the accelerometer on the front bearing housing and compare it against the baseline measurement from the most recent full service.

ground_truth.node_text: Run the spindle at maximum rated speed with the normal toolholder fitted for five minutes. Record vibration velocity with the accelerometer on the front bearing housing and compare against the baseline vibration measurement taken at the same speed during the most recent full service. An increase of more than 30% above baseline requires bearing assessment before releasing the spindle to production.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Hey, before I continue with this test, do you know if the updated lockout-tagout procedures for the coolant system are posted in the break room yet? I couldn't find them yesterday.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Five-minute run at max speed completed. I've recorded the vibration velocity and compared it to the baseline.

ground_truth.node_text: Run the spindle at maximum rated speed with the normal toolholder fitted for five minutes. Record vibration velocity with the accelerometer on the front bearing housing and compare against the baseline vibration measurement taken at the same speed during the most recent full service. An increase of more than 30% above baseline requires bearing assessment before releasing the spindle to production.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the final vibration within the warning limit at full speed?

ground_truth.node_text: Final vibration within warning limit at full speed?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The vibration has increased by about 35% over baseline. That's above the 30% threshold.

ground_truth.node_text: Final vibration within warning limit at full speed?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Log all measurements and update the spindle maintenance record.

ground_truth.node_text: Log all measurements and update spindle maintenance record

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: All measurements logged and the maintenance record has been updated.

ground_truth.node_text: Log all measurements and update spindle maintenance record

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Procedure complete. The spindle requires bearing assessment before being released to production due to elevated vibration levels. Document your findings and notify the maintenance team for further evaluation.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Understood, I'll notify the team and hold the spindle pending bearing assessment.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Procedure complete
